script:
You are a professional screenwriter.

Write a modern screenplay.

Constraints:
- No guns
- No gun violence
- No weapon combat
- No graphic violence
- No copyrighted characters
- Completely original story

Requirements:
- 10–15 scenes
- Proper screenplay format
- INT/EXT scene headers
- Dialogue in uppercase character format
- Realistic pacing

Genre: Sci-Fi
Theme: ambition

Begin screenplay.

Title: ECHOES IN TIME

INT. LAB - NIGHT

Dr. REBECCA SINGH, mid-30s, intense, a brilliant physicist, works at her holographic DESK. She's studying a CRYSTAL formulation, which she calls the Time-Echo Engine.

REBECCA
(whispering to herself)
This could change everything...

INT. LAB - LATER

RICHARD, early 30s, handsome, ambitious, and a fellow scientist, enters the lab. He glances at Rebecca's progress with skepticism.

RICHARD
Is this another dead-end project, Singh?

REBECCA
No, Richard, this is our future.

INT. LAB - DAY

Dr. SINGH and RICHARD present their project to the SCIENTIFIC COMMITTEE. Rebecca explains how the Time-Echo Engine can be used to manipulate time without altering the timeline.

COMMITTEE CHAIRMAN
Fascinating, but how can this technology benefit society?

REBECCA
We can study historical events, improve infrastructure, and even save lives.

RICHARD
But we could also control the past, gain power, and manipulate events to our advantage.

INT. LAB - NIGHT

Rebecca works late into the night. She's exhausted, but her ambition keeps her going. She stumbles upon a groundbreaking discovery.

REBECCA
(excitedly)
I've found it! We can send echoes, not just information, back in time.

INT. LAB - DAY

Rebecca and Richard, filled with excitement, conduct a successful test of the Time-Echo Engine.

REBECCA
(gazing at the hologram)
We did it.

RICHARD
Now, what will you send back, Singh?

INT. LAB - NIGHT

Rebecca, lost in thought, decides to send an echo of herself to the past to prevent her father's untimely death.

INT. LAB - LATER

Rebecca travels back in time, arriving at her childhood home. She's filled with a mix of excitement and apprehension. She meets her younger self and her father.

REBECCA (echo)
Dad, I need you to be careful on the road tomorrow.

INT. LAB - DAY

Back in the present, Rebecca finds her father alive and well. She returns to the lab, elated.

INT. LAB - NIGHT

Richard, envious of Rebecca's success, decides to use the Time-Echo Engine for his own gain. He manipulates the past to gain wealth and power.

INT. LAB - DAY

Rebecca and Richard's relationship deteriorates as they clash over the use of the Time-Echo Engine. A heated argument ensues.

RICHARD
You're just a dreamer, Singh. This technology could change the world, but all you care about is your personal past.

INT. LAB - NIGHT

Rebecca, feeling betrayed, decides to stop Richard. She travels back in time to prevent him from manipulating the past.

INT. LAB - DAY

Rebecca succeeds in stopping Richard, but at a cost. The Time-Echo Engine is damaged, and Rebecca is stranded in the past.

INT. LAB - DAY (present)

The Scientific Committee demands an explanation. Rebecca is forced to reveal the truth about the Time-Echo Engine and its consequences.

COMMITTEE CHAIRMAN
This is unacceptable. We cannot risk the manipulation of the past.

INT. LAB - NIGHT (past)

Rebecca, determined to return to her time, works on repairing the Time-Echo Engine. She manages to return, but at the cost of her own life.

INT. LAB - DAY (present)

The Scientific Committee disbands the project, and Rebecca is mourned as a hero. Her legacy inspires future generations to pursue their dreams, but with caution and respect for the natural order of time.

The end.
